label: FIXED_ROSTER_2, existence extension and…: The type I is a fixed possibilist roster quantified over…
term: fixed roster, existence extension and rigid identity
definition: The type I is a fixed possibilist roster quantified over at every world. ExistsAt W I selects its world-dependent existence extension; actualist quantifiers are represented by guards ex x w. A fixed variable x denotes literally the same Lean individual across worlds, with Lean equality; no counterpart relation or world identity criterion is supplied. A supplied w witnesses a nonempty world type; no axiom makes all existence extensions nonempty. These are stipulated mathematical semantics, not a metaphysical ontology.
note: Theory-relative diagnostic for #435; source-grounded adoption and concreteness defenses remain open. See docs/necessary-individual-quantifiers.md. The linked DeRe is a consuming quantified formula, not a definition of the roster I, world type W or existence extension. In NecessaryIndividual/Quantifiers.lean these types are primitive variable parameters; TruthCore.Isabelle.AFP.NotesOnGoedel.GoedelVariantHOML1.ExistsAt W I is the carrier abbreviation I → W → Prop for the supplied ex predicate. The fixed-roster/rigid-identity interpretation is a stipulated use of those parameters, not a theorem derived from DeRe; its metaphysical applicability remains OPEN. The primary ExistsAt binding is only a PARTIAL vocabulary locator for the existence-family carrier, not a definition of I, W, rigid identity or every quantifier reading. DeRe remains the separately named consuming formula; no alias establishes a metaphysical domain.
